requestBody.title: 請求至廠商的請求主體
requestBody.example:
處理廠商回傳房間硬體狀況，更新PMS的房控
SAMPLE 1: 清潔動作
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<ROWSET>
  <ROW>
    <REVE-CODE>0300TT4190 </REVE-CODE>
    <ROOM_NOS>2403</ROOM_NOS>
    <ACTION_COD>CLEAN</ACTION_COD>
    <!-- clean的action_sta內容：1 -->
    <ACTION_STA>1</ACTION_STA>
    <ACTION_DAT>2009/06/03 10:06:43</ACTION_DAT>
  </ROW>
</ROWSET>

SAMPLE 2: 送全部房況
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<ROWSET>
  <ROW>
    <REVE-CODE>0300TT4190 </REVE-CODE>
    <ROOM_NOS>2403</ROOM_NOS>
    <INS_CARD_INF></INS_CARD_INF>
    <INS_CARD_NO></INS_CARD_NO>
    <ACTION_COD>#ROOM_STA#010101011001#</ACTION_COD>
    <ACTION_STA>1</ACTION_STA>
    <ACTION_DAT>2009/06/03 10:06:43</ACTION_DAT>
  </ROW>
</ROWSET>

SAMPLE 3: 送房間室溫 26C (A7前台才有顯示)
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<ROWSET>
  <ROW>
    <REVE-CODE>0300TT4190 </REVE-CODE>
    <ROOM_NOS>2403</ROOM_NOS>
    <ACTION_COD>#RMTEMP#26C#</ACTION_COD>
    <!-- ACTION_STA 不處理，可省略 -->
    <ACTION_STA>1</ACTION_STA>
    <ACTION_DAT>2009/06/03 10:06:43</ACTION_DAT>
  </ROW>
</ROWSET>
